zh: 格子 (i,j) 的灰度可以拆成行和列两部分：行 i 的 1 数减 0 数，加上列 j 的 1 数减 0 数，两部分互不影响。
行部分为 2×行中 1 的个数 − m，列部分为 2×列中 1 的个数 − n；任意一行与任意一列都有交点，所以分别取最好的行和最好的列即可。
逐行读入，统计该行 1 的个数并更新最大值，同时累加每一列 1 的个数；答案为 2×(最大行 1 数 + 最大列 1 数) − n − m。
en: The grayness of cell (i,j) splits into a row part and a column part: the 1s minus 0s of row i plus the 1s minus 0s of column j, and the two parts do not interact.
The row part is 2 times the 1s in the row minus m, and the column part is 2 times the 1s in the column minus n; every row meets every column, so take the best row and the best column independently.
Read row by row, counting the 1s in each row to update the maximum while adding up the 1s of every column; the answer is 2*(max row ones + max column ones) - n - m.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Count the 1s in each row and in each column; the maximum grayness is 2×(max 1s in a row+max 1s in a column)−n−m.

## Proof of correctness

The row contribution is 2rowOnes−m and the column contribution is 2colOnes−n. The best row and the best column can be chosen independently, and their intersection cell gets both maxima at once.

## Complexity

Time O(nm), space O(m).
